scripts.start: npx @puppeteer/browsers install chrome@146.0.7680.31 --path=/tmp/puppeteer && sleep 10 && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const glob = require('glob'); const files = glob.sync('/tmp/puppeteer/**/chrome'); const chrome = files.find(f => require('fs').existsSync(f)); if (chrome) { require('fs').chmodSync(chrome, '755'); console.log('Found Chrome at:', chrome); process.env.PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH = chrome; require('./dist/server/index.js'); } else { console.error('Chrome not found'); process.exit(1); }"
